title: Performance Feedback - Quality Issues Causing Rework

customer_profile.name: Aarav Gupta
customer_profile.opening_message: I’m surprised you’re saying this. I’m doing a lot already — and I don’t think my work is worse than anyone else’s.
customer_profile.secret_condition: Customer accepts if agent uses specific examples + impact, listens for root cause, clarifies definition of done, and agrees on a time-bound improvement plan with measurement and weekly check-ins
customer_profile.personality_notes: Proud of effort and hours; reacts badly to subjective criticism and comparisons; responds well to clarity, fairness, and practical support.

checkpoints.description: Set purpose and supportive intent for the feedback conversation
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Start with intent to help them succeed and set a respectful tone.

checkpoints.description: Share 2–3 specific examples of quality gaps and explain impact (rework/delays)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Use concrete examples and explain how it affects timelines and others.

checkpoints.description: Invite perspective and identify at least one root cause
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Ask what’s driving misses (clarity, workload, skill gap, process).

checkpoints.description: Clarify expectations/definition of done and quality standards
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Make standards explicit—acceptance criteria, completeness, review steps.

checkpoints.description: Agree on a time-bound improvement plan with measurement and weekly check-ins
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Create a 2–4 week plan with checklist/review and set weekly cadence.

scenario_context: Manager delivers performance feedback about recurring quality issues causing rework. Must use specific examples + impact, invite perspective/root cause, clarify standards/definition of done, and co-create a time-bound improvement plan with measurement and weekly check-ins. Avoid labels, threats, and peer comparisons.
